objective: Reduce residual MFT and ISRJ false positives using matched hard-negative training without changing frozen E5, B3-R features, decision thresholds, or router architecture
frozen: B2-RC MFT three-state router architecture and action probabilities

training.paired_view_rule: nine power views remain grouped; each identity has constant total base weight
training.hard_negative_concentration: top half receives 5x raw weight and bottom half 0.2x before class normalization
training.matched_definition: same power and same labels excluding the target; hardness is the mean within-stratum percentile of frozen E5 and frozen physical-expert scores

selection.eligibility: target AUPR delta >= 0 and recall drop <= 0.01 relative to B2-RC
selection.objective: maximum target FPR reduction, then maximum target AUPR delta
